description: Named variables of map1_s01 (School - 2F) that its Lua reads and writes with sh.map.get / sh.map.set or passes by name ("name[i]"). Each entry says where the value lives: "symbol" (an array of tables.json or a game variable shared with the engine; with "storage" too, the storage is used where the symbol is missing), "object" (the draw records of world_objects.json, starting at that object) or "storage" (a value only the scripts keep, alive for the whole run); "type" is s8/u8/s16/u16/s32/u32 (default s32) or ref (an address); "count" elements lie "stride" bytes apart from "offset". "layout" gives several names at once: vec3 (.x/.y/.z, s32 Q12 metres), svec3 (s16, Q12 turns for angles), pose (.pos, .rot) and placement (.pos). Variables every map shares are in gamedata/config/map_vars.json; this file is looked up first, and a mod patches it with its own copy. On map1_s01 (school 2F): smoke_emitter.* are the fields of the locker-room smoke column (area, opacity, kind, particle count, top and bottom y, radius, rise speed, fade rate, centre x/z in Q12 metres, keep-alive); effect_slot_type is the type byte of each map effect slot (20-byte entries); falling_object_speed is the fall speed of the medallion (world object 0).
